Canva is a browser-based design tool. You drag text, photos, shapes and templates onto a page, then download or share the result. Let's look at the home screen. Create a design starts a new project. Templates shows ready-made designs. Brand appears on paid plans and stores your logos and colours. Start on the free plan. Check the pricing page for current plan details before you decide to upgrade.

20261107-0234-canva-course-voice-01

Script

Let's create a secure account. Use a work email, and a password manager for a long, unique password. Go to canva.com, click Sign up, and choose Google, Apple or email. Confirm your email. You do not need a card to use the free plan. Then open Settings and turn on two-step verification. Remember: never enter card details from a link someone else sent you.

#5voicevoice-en-standardcommercial_ok: yes

Job

20261107-0236-canva-course-voice-01

Script

Canva designs happen in the editor. The top bar holds file options, undo, resize and share. The context toolbar changes with what you select. The left panel holds templates, elements, text and your uploads. The canvas is where you work, and the page bar at the bottom holds multi-page designs. Let's make a post. Add a headline, a shape, and a photo. Group and lock the background. Duplicate the design with Control D. When you're ready, download as PNG.
